cuts.reason: Cuts from the single locked-off bedroom shot straight to a black end card right after the wife's deadpan punchline ('That man was trying to get married'), giving the joke a beat to land before the branding/CTA tag appears.

pacing_notes: This short has almost no cutting: the entire joke (setup line, punchline, and the couple's phone-scrolling reactions) plays out in one continuous static shot lasting about 9 seconds, so all the comedic timing comes from performance and dialogue delivery rather than editing rhythm. The only cut in the whole video is the hard cut at the very end into a ~1-second black title/CTA card ('LOW BATTERY PEOPLE... NEW EPISODE DAILY'), which functions as a branded outro rather than a story beat.
